pl-l2d2c6-d1e113.summary: Asks how, if angels were in the empyrean as soon as made, Isaiah reports Lucifer saying 'I will ascend into heaven, exalt my throne, and be like the Most High.'

pl-l2d2c6-d1e129.summary: Answers that 'heaven' there means God's height, to which he wished to be equal: 'I will ascend into heaven' means to equality with God.

pl-l2d2c6.summary: Asks how, if angels were in the empyrean as soon as made, Lucifer could say 'I will ascend into heaven... I will be like the Most High' (Isa 14:13). 'Heaven' there means God's height, to which he wished to be equal: 'I will ascend into heaven' means to equality with God.
claims: Lucifer's 'heaven' (Isa 14:13) means equality with God, not a place.
The angels were already in the empyrean.
